main_body: multi-story brick building with mansard roof
top_band: blue-grey mansard roof and upper roof deck with orange eave trim from rows 16 to 45
evidence: The building features a clear 30-row mansard roof top band (rows 16-45) ending in a distinct orange cornice highlight (row 44) and dark eave shadow (rows 46-47) above a 97-row vertical brick facade with recessed windows.

style.evidence: Uses heavy near-black outlines around the roof, dormers, and chimney rather than colored material tones, and relies on repetitive blocky brick patterns rather than the intricate per-tile grain of the references.
